format: Standard Technical English technical implementation rules
authority: Owner-authorized technical policy under the unchanged Method. No underscore prefixes is an explicit owner override, not a Microsoft prohibition.

rules.instruction: Consult current official Microsoft guidance for the approved technology. Treat historical examples as evidence rather than current API instructions.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within baseline bounds; human owner for framework amendments

rules.instruction: Do not use underscore naming prefixes, including _, __, m_, s_, and t_. A standalone language discard is not a naming prefix.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within baseline bounds; human owner for framework amendments

rules.when: Naming private or internal non-constant fields
rules.instruction: Use unprefixed camelCase for instance and static fields. Qualify instance-field access with this.; use the declaring type when static qualification is needed.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within baseline bounds; human owner for framework amendments

rules.instruction: Use PascalCase for types, namespaces, methods, properties, events, and constants. Prefix interfaces with I. Use camelCase for parameters and ordinary locals. Preserve Method component semantics and suffixes.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within baseline bounds; human owner for framework amendments

rules.instruction: Select supported stable tooling through the Solution Architect. Record the SDK and roll-forward policy in global.json. Use the target-framework-compatible language default or an explicit compatible version. Do not set LangVersion to latest or preview.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within baseline bounds; human owner for framework amendments

rules.instruction: Use supported modern features when they improve clarity or correctness. Use braces, four-space indentation, and consistent formatting.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within baseline bounds; human owner for framework amendments

rules.instruction: Enable nullable analysis. Annotate optional references. Resolve warnings instead of disabling analysis or adding unjustified null-forgiving operators.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within baseline bounds; human owner for framework amendments

rules.instruction: Validate arguments with appropriate supported APIs. Handle exceptions where recovery or approved boundary translation is possible. Preserve the original stack on rethrow. Do not silently swallow failures.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within baseline bounds; human owner for framework amendments

rules.instruction: Use async and await for asynchronous I/O. Return awaitable tasks except where event-handler signatures require async void. Avoid blocking with Wait or Result. Preserve reviewed contracts and cancellation semantics.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within baseline bounds; human owner for framework amendments

rules.instruction: Apply current Microsoft library guidance inside approved boundaries. Local properties and events do not authorize property-like service operations or forbidden event publishers.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within baseline bounds; human owner for framework amendments

rules.instruction: Enable SDK analyzers, nullable checks, and build-time style checks. Use the recommended analysis mode for the pinned SDK. Make warnings fail the quality gate. Record diagnostic decisions.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within baseline bounds; human owner for framework amendments

rules.instruction: Configure EditorConfig naming rules and explicit build severity for IDE1006. Run dotnet format with --verify-no-changes in addition to builds and tests.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within baseline bounds; human owner for framework amendments

rules.instruction: Do not weaken rules, add blanket suppressions, mark owned code generated, or alter SDK/build settings to make work pass. Route justified exceptions through the responsible architect with QA review and revision-bound evidence.
rules.basis: Owner enforcement policy; S4 explains configuration mechanics
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within baseline bounds; human owner for framework amendments

rules.instruction: Recheck official sources at baseline creation, planned SDK upgrades, and pattern changes. Record review date and impact. Obtain Solution Architect approval for baseline changes.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within baseline bounds; human owner for framework amendments
